sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.28 "FDCAN Rx FIFO 0 acknowledge register (FDCAN_RXF0A)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3705.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00A8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:0 F0AI[5:0]: Rx FIFO 0 acknowledge index
After the user has read a message or a sequence of messages from Rx FIFO 0 it must write the
buffer index of the last element read from Rx FIFO 0 to F0AI. This sets the Rx FIFO 0 get index
FDCAN_RXF0S.F0GI to F0AI + 1 and update the FIFO 0 fill level FDCAN_RXF0S.F0FL.
